evidence.limits: The Reel is a 3.0 s static image with a completely silent track (loudness -90 dB in every window), so there is no speech or music to transcribe; no whisper.srt exists and none is expected. Only 3 hook sheets exist because the Reel is shorter than 4 sheets' worth (the brief's 4 do not apply). The image looks like a screenshot of a social post; whether it is a real post by Matan (an X or Twitter-style layout) is not verifiable from the frames. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: A text 'don't' list (a screenshot styled like an X post by @MatanNistor) with eight provocative rules: don't go to school, don't get a degree, don't be an employee, don't buy a house, don't save for a pension, don't watch the news, don't get the Covid vaccine, don't listen to people who have not achieved what you want, plus a prompt to write which you agree with most.
audience: His followers; people open to contrarian life and money rules; also a critical audience who argue in the comments.
caption_vs_video_note: Caption 'תרשמו בתגובות באיזה סעיף אתם הכי מאמינים. אפשר יותר מ-1' repeats the prompt in the image, so it matches. The cover is the same screenshot.

opening.first_frame: Black screen with a post-style card: a gold-ringed profile photo of Matan, the name 'מתן ניסטור' with a diamond and a blue check and a Hebrew tag, handle '@MatanNistor', then the list.
opening.s0_1: The whole card is already complete in frame 1; nothing moves.
opening.s3_5: n/a: the Reel ends at 3.0 s.
opening.visual_hook: A dense eight-line list in post format, white on black.
opening.text_hook: רשימת ה״אל״: / 1. אל תלכו (או תשלחו את הילדים שלכם) לבית הספר
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: 'רשימת ה״אל״' introduces a list of things not to do, and item 1 is self-contained

visual.subject_placement: A text card in the vertical middle, left-aligned in RTL with a profile photo at top right.
visual.setting: Plain black background (a screenshot of a social post).
visual.color_contrast: White text on pure black, a gold ring around the avatar, emoji as the only colour.
visual.persistent_branding: Profile name, verified check and handle '@MatanNistor' at the top of the card.
visual.cover_matches_video: yes: the cover is the same card.
visual.ui_interference: The whole card sits between roughly 22 and 82 percent of the height; the top 14 percent and the bottom of the frame are empty, so nothing is covered.

editing.edit_function: None: a still image held for 3 seconds, so the Reel is effectively a screenshot that loops quickly.
editing.ending: Same card at 3.0 s; the card's last line is 'תרשמו למה הכי התחברתם' with a pointing-down emoji.
editing.loop: yes (a static 3 s image that restarts immediately, so every play restarts the same card)
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: nobody can read eight items and an emoji prompt in under 3 s without a replay, so views may count multiple loops.

sound.delivery: No audio at all: every half-second window is -90 dB.

text.placement: Centre of the frame in RTL, right-aligned list.
text.style: System sans in the style of an X post: light white on black, with emoji after each item.
text.density_and_read_time: Eight numbered items and a prompt, about 55 words; needs about 8 to 10 seconds to read at normal speed (the Reel lasts 3 s).
text.language: Imperative negatives ('אל תלכו', 'אל תעשו תואר', 'אל תהיו שכירים'), one-line items, a hashtag-free tone, emoji reactions (a thumbs-down, a vomiting face, a crying face, a house, banknotes, a TV with a red X, a syringe, a person); the list is the provocative core.
text.caption_structure: Two lines: an opinion prompt asking in which item you believe most, plus 'you can choose more than one'; no hashtags.
text.rtl_notes: Item numbers appear after the Hebrew words ('...1.אל תלכו'), i.e. the digit-then-period sits at the right of each line in the screenshot, a mixed-direction rendering quirk; the card's 'ה״אל״' quotes are mirrored.

story.stakes: Implied: following the mainstream leads you astray.
story.progression: Eight numbered items from school to listening to people who have not achieved your goal.
story.payoff: The prompt to write which item you agree with.
story.payoff_delivered: yes: the full list is visible, though not readable in 3 s without a replay
friction_points: t=0-3s: the text is too long to read in the runtime (interpretation)
t=0-3s: items about health and the news (Covid vaccine) may alienate (interpretation)

explicit_prompts.wording: תרשמו בתגובות באיזה סעיף אתם הכי מאמינים

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 45 comments is not representative. Many answer the prompt with item numbers ('8', '6!!!!', 'התחברתי ל 3, 5,7,8') or 'הכל', which is a plain comment-opinion prompt rather than a keyword funnel; there is also pushback about the house and pension items ('למה לא להפקיד לפנסיה ??') and the vaccine item.
engagement.creator_reply_pattern: Short emoji replies (fire) and one terse 'תנשום' to a critic.

conversion.funnel_entry_visible: none (the comment prompt is open-ended, not a keyword for a DM)
conversion.cta_fits_content: yes: a poll-style comment prompt after a list of opinions

pair_match.notes: n/a (top Reel; dossier pair is null)

rights_and_privacy: No third-party content apart from the post-style layout (an imitation of a social platform's interface); no bystanders.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a 3-second, zero-production, highly polarising list with a built-in comment prompt (257 comments, 1.38 per 1,000 views), and the very short loop probably inflates view counts.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: no human face, voice or story, and the Covid and news items may cost trust; likes per view are modest (5.6 per 1,000).

standout_moments.what: Everything at once: the full list is on screen in the first frame, so there is no hook delay.
The loop restart (the Reel ends where it began), which forces a second read.
